## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹², D = 0

Raw traces first, then the tone inventory (`sdh_onset`) and windowed FFTs in 1/B (`sdh_fft`), against the run-5 calibration's full-density Luttinger frequency F_L = |n|h/4e.

**Run 6 (electron, F_L = 33.1 T):** dominant light tone **7.1 T** (onset below the 0.3 T record edge, SNR ≤ 89 including harmonic content at 14.1/22.1/29.5 T) riding a strong feature above 7.5 T (R → 530 Ω, ν = 4·(33.1/B) ≈ 13–16 there). The 3–10 T FFT peaks near **30 T** — degenerate between 4×7.1 harmonics and a genuine heavy band (two-band ABAB model predicts 7.5 + 25.6 T; sum closure 7.1 + 26 ≈ 33 ✓). **Run 7 (hole, F_L = 12.4 T):** two close tones **4.7 and 6.6 T** (sum 11.3 vs 12.4 — 90 % closure; ABAB model pair 5.3/7.1 T), high harmonic content, R → 590 Ω at 10 T.

**Read:** both carrier signs show multi-component SdH consistent with a two-band (Bernal-like) Fermi surface and inconsistent with a single 4-fold surface carrying the full density (no dominant tone at F_L on either side). Not yet a call: the high-F content is harmonic-degenerate and the hole-side closure is 90 %. The Landau fan (next) separates harmonics (k·f₁(n) tracks) from a real heavy band (own n-slope) and reads the gap/crossing pattern directly.

"""SdH spot checks, runs 6 (electron n=+3.2e12, B 0->10 T) and 7 (hole n=-1.2e12, 10->0.3 T):
raw R(B), sdh_onset tone tables, windowed sdh_fft vs the run-5-calibration Luttinger frequency."""
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

SPOTS = {6: ("electron", +3.2e16), 7: ("hole", -1.2e16)}  # n in m^-2 (SI)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(12, 10))

for j, (rid, (side, n_si)) in enumerate(SPOTS.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain                     # drain current, A
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / np.abs(I)       # Rxx B_1-B_2, Ohm
    order = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[order], R[order]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(n_si)
    print(f"run {rid} ({side}, n = {n_si*1e-16:+.2f}e12 cm^-2): {len(B)} pts, "
          f"B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, R {R.min():.1f}-{R.max():.1f} Ohm | F_L(4-fold) = {FL:.1f} T")

    # raw first
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.7)
    ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid} {side}: raw R vs B")
    ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("R (Ohm)")

    # tone inventory (r_full_scale = 50 uV / 10 nA = 5 kOhm)
    try:
        print(sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.3, r_full_scale=5000.0).summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"  sdh_onset failed: {e}")

    # windowed FFTs in 1/B
    for b_lo, style in ((1.5, "-"), (3.0, "--")):
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(b_lo, B.max()), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False)
        ax[1, j].plot(f, sp[0] / sp[0].max(), style, lw=0.8, label=f"B {b_lo}-{B.max():.0f} T")
    ax[1, j].axvline(FL, color="r", ls=":", label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    for frac, c in ((0.5, "g"), (0.25, "orange")):
        ax[1, j].axvline(FL * frac, color=c, ls=":", alpha=0.6)
    ax[1, j].set_xlim(0, 1.6 * FL); ax[1, j].legend(fontsize=7)
    ax[1, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("FFT amp (norm)")
    ax[1, j].set_title(f"run {rid}: SdH FFT (F_L, F_L/2, F_L/4 marked)")

    # background-subtracted oscillations vs 1/B
    sel = B >= 1.0
    bg = np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[sel], R[sel], 5), B[sel])
    ax[2, j].plot(1 / B[sel], R[sel] - bg, lw=0.6)
    ax[2, j].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[2, j].set_ylabel("dR (Ohm)")
    ax[2, j].set_title(f"run {rid}: dR vs 1/B (deg-5 bg in B, B > 1 T)")

fig.tight_layout()

## HERA — Step 5: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking-call centerpiece

> **05:26** · landau-fan @ D=0 (run-5 cal): n fast -1.25..+3.25e12 (181 pts, dn 0.025, TG/BG co-swept), B slow 1..10 T ascending (121 rows, 75 mT); sr1 200 uV (20 kOhm FS), fast\_delay 1.0 s; leak trip 1 nA; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~14:26** (≈9h)

Plan step 5 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`). Runs 6/7 (ana cell above) show multi-component SdH on both carrier signs, leaning two-band/Bernal, but the high-F content (22–30 T, e-side) is degenerate between harmonics of the 7.1 T light tone and a genuine heavy band, and the hole-side sum closes only to 90 %. The fan resolves this: a harmonic tracks k·f₁(n), a real band has its own n-slope; and the gap-line inventory (filling factors, LL-crossing pattern, ν = 0 evolution) is the direct stacking discriminant — one 4-fold family → ABCA, light+heavy ladders with crossings → ABAB, monolayer-like + heavy hybrid → ABCB.

**Geometry:** fast axis n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² cm⁻² (181 pts, Δn = 0.025), gates co-swept along the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line via `multimegasweep` — (V_tg, V_bg) from (−0.291, −0.484) to (+0.998, +1.185) V, inside the validators (V_tg tops out 2 mV under the +1.0 V limit). Slow axis B = 1.0 → 10.0 T ascending (magnet sits at 0; never re-traverse — the run ends at 10 T and whatever follows rides down), 75 mT → 121 rows; ν = 4 spacing is 3.9 fast-points at 1 T, 39 at 10 T. **Sensitivity trade, stated:** sr1 fixed at 200 µV = 20 kΩ FS — the ν = 0 CNP stripe at high B will clip above ~21 kΩ and the clip itself marks the gap; in exchange the 50–600 Ω SdH features stay ≥ 0.25 % FS (0.4 % readable per runs 0–3). **Coverage trade:** B < 1 T omitted (fan lines crowd below the ν-resolution at T_e ≈ 8 K; run-6 onset data already covers 0.3–1 T at one density), hole side ends at n = −1.25 (TG −0.3 V limit — full hole-side coverage is not purchasable inside the committed box).

**Pacing/price:** fast_delay 1.0 s (= run-5 pacing, 1.17 s/pt measured incl. turnaround, τ = 0.3 s @ 24 dB — knowingly at 3.3 τ for a quasi-continuous 7 mV fast step); row ≈ 4.2 min (181 pts + 33 s B-step ramp + settle + flyback) → 8.6 h computed, headline **≈ 9 h** (session actuals run 5–10 % over). Leak guard trips at 1 nA on either Keithley. Checkpoints: first rows at 1 T (rail outside the CNP stripe / dead channel / leak → abort), then reads at ~2.5, 5, 7.5 T — kill if no n-dependent Landau structure by 3 T; `hera-watch --next --follow` armed.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): n fast -1.25 -> +3.25e12 (181), B slow 1 -> 10 T (121 rows, 75 mT) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.25, 181)                    # 1e12 cm^-2, dn = 0.025
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.075), 4)      # ascending, ends at 10 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts); Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V, "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V | slow: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan ramps up from 0), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA (CNP stripe clips >~21 kOhm at high B
# -- the clip marks the nu=0 gap; SdH features 50-600 Ohm stay >= 0.25 % FS).
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (20 kOhm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan: n fast -1.25..+3.25e12 (181, dn 0.025) along D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  "B slow 1..10 T (121 rows, 75 mT), sr1 200 uV, fast_delay 1.0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: n -1.25 -> +3.25e12 cm^-2 fast (181 pts, dn 0.025), B 1 -> 10 T slow (121 rows, 75 mT); '
              f'Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V; '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'sr1 200 uV (20 kOhm FS), fast_delay 1.0 s')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                 slow_delay=1.0, fast_delay=1.0)
# ends at 10 T, n = +3.25e12 -- no park: the next step rides the field down (never re-traverse).
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, "
      f"T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
